review_notes: Bangladesh ordinary passport holders are not on Kosovo's official short-stay visa-exempt nationality list and require a prior short-stay Visa C. The Kosovo-Bangladesh visa-free agreement in the Official Gazette is expressly limited to diplomatic and official passports; ordinary passports are not covered. Special exemption: a traveller from a visa-required country who holds a valid biometric residence permit issued by a Schengen state or a valid multiple-entry Schengen visa may enter, transit and stay in Kosovo for up to 15 days. Visa C is for visits under three months; general foreigners law permits stays up to three months per six-month period. Apply in person at the relevant Kosovo diplomatic/consular mission; the official Embassy portal lists the Kosovo Embassy in Dhaka. The official visa page states a EUR40 Visa C fee, passport valid at least three months after departure, two blank pages, recent ICAO photo, purpose/accommodation/funds/health-insurance evidence, English or official-language translations, and two copies. Processing time is not published.
